jobs.title: IMG Integration and Experience Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Full-Time, 40 Hours/Week

Day Shift

Onsite

Summary

The International Medical Graduate (IMG) Integration & Experience Coordinator leads Akron Children's Hospital's non-clinical integration program for International Medical Graduates, international fellows, and their eligible family members.

Serving as the primary resource for IMG transition and integration, this role supports physicians and families throughout the full training journey, from recruitment and pre-arrival planning through onboarding, transitions, and program completion. The coordinator works across departments and with external partners to help physicians navigate organizational processes, immigration-related administrative requirements, and community integration.

This position proactively identifies and removes barriers to physician success, engagement, retention, and overall experience. The coordinator maintains current knowledge of immigration-related administrative processes affecting international physicians, monitors regulatory and policy changes, coordinates institutional responses within established organizational guidelines, and translates complex requirements into practical guidance while maintaining appropriate legal boundaries. The position also supports organizational culture enhancement by helping identify and address barriers to collaboration, communication, and the successful integration of physicians and staff across diverse backgrounds.

Using data, participant feedback, and institutional trends, the coordinator recommends process improvements that strengthen organizational readiness, improve the physician and family experience, and support Akron Children's commitment to becoming a destination institution for international medical education.

Responsibilities

Develop, coordinate, and continuously improve Akron Children's IMG Integration and Experience Program, providing structured non-clinical support from pre-arrival through completion of residency or fellowship.
Manage a portfolio of IMG physicians and international fellows throughout the training lifecycle by maintaining regular connections, assessing and tracking transition needs, monitoring key milestones and emerging barriers, documenting follow-up, and coordinating appropriate resources and cross-functional support.
Responsible for managing assigned physician visa sponsorship processes in partnership with Medical Education, including applications, documentation, arrival requirements, renewals, trainee communication, and year-round tracking. Prioritizes time-sensitive issues and coordinates escalation to authorized departments for legal, eligibility, trainee-status, and compliance determinations.
Maintain current working knowledge of immigration-related policies, administrative requirements, and processes affecting International Medical Graduates. Monitor relevant changes and coordinate approved updates to institutional workflows, timelines, resources, and communications.
Identify, investigate, and coordinate resolution of administrative, organizational, and community barriers affecting IMG physicians and their families by collaborating with internal departments, external agencies, and community partners.
Coordinate resources related to Social Security administration, driver's licensing, housing, banking, transportation, payroll, benefits, healthcare access, education, childcare, and other transition needs for physicians and eligible family members.
Exercise independent judgment in prioritizing complex situations, determining appropriate escalation pathways, and coordinating cross-functional solutions that support physician success and organizational effectiveness.
Develop and maintain partnerships with community organizations, government agencies, educational institutions, cultural organizations, and service providers to expand resources and strengthen support for IMG physicians and their families.
Plan and coordinate institutional onboarding, transition education, networking, cultural experiences, and community engagement opportunities that promote preparedness, belonging, cultural adjustment, and long-term integration.
Connect IMG physicians and their families with appropriate organizational and community resources based on identified transition needs.
Serve as the primary non-clinical liaison for IMG integration, coordinating communication, roles, handoffs, and services among Medical Education, Human Resources, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Information Technology, Graduate Medical Education leadership, residency coordinators, and other organizational partners.
Provide consultation and education to residency coordinators, department leaders, and organizational partners regarding IMG integration processes, available resources, role boundaries, and organizational practices that support a consistent trainee experience.
Develop and maintain standardized workflows, program resources, tracking systems, and process documentation that support consistent IMG integration services.
Collection and analyze program data, participant feedback, and recurring barriers; prepare reports and recommendations for leadership; and identify improvements to organizational workflows, communications, resources, and support services.
Perform other duties as required.

Other Information

Technical Expertise

Demonstrated ability to independently coordinate a complex portfolio of International Medical Graduates and international fellows, balancing competing priorities, time-sensitive deadlines, and interdependent processes across the physician-training lifecycle.
Working knowledge of immigration-related administrative processes affecting international physicians and trainees, including authorized sponsorship pathways, Intealth, ECFMG, SEVIS-related processes, documentation requirements, renewals, extensions, and institutional dependencies. Ability to monitor evolving requirements and communicate operational impacts while maintaining appropriate legal boundaries.
Strong understanding of graduate medical education, physician onboarding, healthcare operations, and organizational systems, with the ability to navigate complex structures, clarify responsibilities, and coordinate cross-functional solutions.
Demonstrated systems-thinking, consultation, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify administrative and systemic barriers, analyze complex situations, exercise sound judgment, influence outcomes without direct authority, and coordinate timely responses involving internal and external stakeholders.
Experience developing program infrastructure and evaluating effectiveness, including standardized workflows, resource materials, tracking systems, process documentation, data analysis, trend identification, and preparation of reports and recommendations for leadership.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex administrative processes into practical guidance, build trusting relationships across diverse cultural and professional groups, maintain confidentiality,
Proficiency in MS Office [Outlook, Excel, Word] or similar software is required including relevant databases or case-management systems to support program administration.

Education And Experience

Education: Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Human Services, Social Work, or a related field is required. Master's degree preferred.
Certification: Completion of an employer-approved professional certification or certificate program related to immigration administration, international education, intercultural competence (IDI), project management, case management, or another job-related specialty is required within twelve (12) months of hire. Ongoing professional development related to immigration processes, international medical education, and physician integration are expected.
Years of experience: Minimum of four (4) years of relevant experience in healthcare administration, graduate medical education, physician or employee onboarding, international education, immigration administration, or a related field required. Experience supporting international physicians, healthcare professionals, scholars, students, or other globally mobile populations is strongly preferred.
Years of experience supervising: None required

Full Time

FTE: 1.000000

Status: Onsite

jobs.description:
Case Manager – ABA Center (Tucson, AZ)

Full-Time | Comprehensive Benefits

Lead with Purpose. Empower with Expertise. Make an Impact.

Who We Are

At Applied ABC, we’re passionate about helping children with autism thrive! Our team is dedicated to providing exceptional, data-driven ABA therapy that makes a real difference in everyday life. We believe in empowering children, supporting families, and creating a positive, collaborative environment where every team member can grow and make an impact.

We are looking for a motivated ABA Case Manager to join our team in Tucson, AZ. This role is ideal for someone committed to helping families, providing excellent care, and making a real difference in children’s lives.

Why You’ll Love Being Part of Applied ABC

Make a Difference: Empower children to build skills, confidence, and independence through ABA therapy.
Lead with Purpose: Guide families, collaborate with providers, and support staff to ensure care is consistent and effective.
Advance Your Career: Be part of a growing organization that invests in its team and promotes from within.
Your Voice Matters: Your insight and dedication will directly impact the success and outcomes of the Center.

Where You’ll Make an Impact

As the ABA Case Manager, you’ll coordinate and oversee client programs to ensure each child receives consistent, high-quality care. You’ll serve as a key point of contact for families and staff, support program implementation, and help maintain the center’s standards of excellence.

Role Overview:

  Program Coordination & Oversight

Manage staff availability to guarantee continuous, high-quality client care.
Use utilization data to review client programs and ensure consistent, reliable service.
Support families by highlighting the benefits of ongoing therapy and active engagement. 

      Family & Provider Support

Serve as the main point of contact for parents and providers, addressing questions, needs, concerns, and connecting them to additional resources.
Engage with families and staff professionally, with care and sensitivity

      Training & Staff Development

Assist with onboarding and training of new staff to support seamless integration into the team.
Provide guidance and support to staff to help them follow center standards and best practices. 

      Additional Responsibilities

Perform other duties assigned to support the overall success of the center

What Sets You Apart

Brings 2 years of professional experience in an office environment, with previous experience in case management or family support within the ABA field.
Skilled at prioritizing responsibilities, managing time effectively, and multitasking in fast-paced environment
Comfortable working with staff in office settings
Committed to meeting families where they are, offering empathy and honoring each family’s individual story
Dedicated to safeguarding sensitive information and practicing full confidentiality and HIPAA compliance
Turns challenges into actionable steps with a solution-oriented approach.
Well-versed in Microsoft Suite applications

What We Offer

We are committed to supporting you professionally with a comprehensive total rewards package, including :

Comprehensive benefits package

o    Medical, dental, and vision insurance

o    Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays

o    401(k) with employer match

o    Professional growth and advancement opportunities

Where You’ll Work

Location:  8257 East Broadway Blvd Tucson, AZ, 85710
Schedule: Monday – Friday with weekend availability
Work Type: In Office

Join a Mission That Matters

If you’re passionate about helping others and ready to grow your career, this is your chance to guide families, make meaningful connections, and create a lasting impact in your community.

At Applied ABC, you’ll find more than a workplace, you’ll find a purpose.

Apply today and help us shape brighter futures together.

jobs.title: Education Specialist Hawthorn Children's Psychiatric Hospital
jobs.description:
Hawthorn Children’s Psychiatric Hospital provides specialized care for adolescents diagnosed with mental health disorders. We are looking for a positive and energetic teacher to work collaboratively with a team of educators.

This unit will work closely with community partners and collaborate with our adolescent’s community schools. This person must have an interest in helping adolescents with mental health disorders while maximizing each student’s potential. Our educators provide instruction to youth in our Inpatient and Residential Programs guided by a Missouri DESE course of study, but have the ability, as well, to exercise creativity and flexibility in adapting coursework to fit the needs and abilities of the students you teach.

Your time with the students allows you to see the difference we make in the lives of the children in our care. As a teacher at Hawthorn, you will receive ongoing guidance and training with the ability to collaborate with peers, work intensively with other disciplines, and receive classroom support; all while providing you the opportunity to flourish in your professional in your role with the students and the facility.

Responsibilities

Individualize instruction to meet student needs in a mixed placement, mixed ability classroom of 4-8 students.
Revise, develop and implement Individual Education Plans (IEPs) and Section 504 Plans.
Attend and contribute to multi-disciplinary meetings regarding students in your classroom.
Develop treatment goals for classroom use and report on those goals weekly.
Model and teach social skills to the students in your classroom.
Keep attendance and academic records and report on those records at specific times.

The qualified candidate will have at minimum a Bachelor’s Degree in Education from an accredited university and
have 4 years of post-baccalaureate teaching experience in a school accredited by a state approved governing agency. The candidate must possess a Missouri Department of Elementary and Secondary Education Lifetime or Career Continuous Professional Certification (CCPC) noting an area of special education.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess The Following Skills

Ability to write effective Individualized Education Plans (IEPs) with limited assistance.
A basic knowledge of Microsoft Products especially word and excel

Reports to the Education Program Manager and the Chief of Clinical Services.

The State of Missouri offers an excellent benefits package that includes a defined pension plan, generous amounts of leave and holiday time, and eligibility for health insurance coverage. Your total compensation is more than the dollars you receive in your paycheck. To help demonstrate the value of working for the State of Missouri, we have created an interactive Total Compensation Calculator. This tool provides a comprehensive view of benefits and more that are offered to prospective employees. The Total Compensation Calculator and other applicant resources can be found here.

Additional Benefits

Opportunity to experience multiple areas within the facility
Friendly and supportive work environment
No requirement to work weekends or evenings
No on-call work
Generous and flexible options for time off
Collaboration with a multi-disciplinary team
Tuition Reimbursement
Public Service Loan Forgiveness
Opportunities to participate in different committees within the facility

For questions, please contact the Human Resources office at: Michael.Tillman@dmh.mo.gov

jobs.title: Retail Safety Program Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Realize
new levels of autonomy and professional ownership. At Ulta Beauty, our Legal, Risk & Governance team provides clarity and continuity in ways that have made our growth a seamless venture, with keen insights that have opened up new and previously unexplored areas of opportunity. Through superior leadership and work that continually challenges, you’ll have the chance to help set strategic direction through ethical and collaborative thought and practice.

THE IMPACT YOU CAN HAVE

The Retail Safety Program Manager leads the execution and continuous improvement of Ulta Beauty’s Beautifully Safe program across all Ulta Beauty retail store locations. The role is responsible for developing, implementing and managing retail store safety programs that protect employees, guests and company assets. This role partners closely with Store Operations, Risk Management, Asset Protection, People Success and Growth & Development to reduce workplace injuries, ensure regulatory compliance, improve safety performance, and foster a culture of safety throughout Ulta Beauty’s retail store locations.

YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH THESE GOALS BY:

Safety Program Management

Develop and maintain retail store safety policies and procedures
Lead company-wide store safety initiatives focused on injury prevention and risk mitigation
Standardize safety practices across all store locations
Evaluate safety performance metrics and implement continuous improvement and operational excellence strategies
Prepare reports and presentations for senior leadership outlining safety performance, trends, and program effectiveness.

Regulatory Compliance

Ensure regulatory compliance with OSHA and all applicable federal, state and local safety regulations
Perform investigations related to OSHA complaints and inspections, including documentation and follow-up.
Serve as liaison with government agencies and inspectors
Maintain required safety documentation and records
Monitor changes in regulatory requirements and update policies accordingly
Benchmark safety program with retail professionals across the industry, attend conferences and stay active in industry trade associations
Track and support contagious disease control programs, including reporting and regulatory compliance.

Incident Management

Conduct investigations and root cause analysis of employee and guest injuries and incidents
Prepare injury prevention action plans
Monitor workers’ compensation and general liability trends

Store Safety Audits

Perform safety audits, safety assessments and inspections, in person and on CCTV
Identify hazards and partner with store management and field leaders to ensure corrective actions are completed
Review safety equipment, housekeeping, ergonomics and fire prevention.

Training & Development

Design and lead safety training for store field leadership and associates, including tracking completion and effectiveness.
Manage ongoing safety awareness initiatives through communications, meetings, and engagement programs across the enterprise.
Train field leaders and store associates on polices and safety best practices
Prepare reports and presentations for leadership outlining safety performance, trends, and program effectiveness.

Risk Reduction

Analyze safety and risk-related data to identify trends and recommend mitigation strategies.
Evaluate and implement safety-related technologies and tools to improve risk mitigation.
Partner with Operations and Facilities to address physical hazards
Manage business relationships with third party safety solution providers

Emergency Preparedness

Coordinate and support safety committees, safety captain programs, and emergency response initiatives such as evacuation and shelter-in-place procedures
Partner with Business Continuity, Asset Protection and Store Operations on emergency response incidents and procedures
Develop and support emergency procedures at Ulta Beauty’s corporate headquarters

The Essentials Of Success

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
5–7 years of experience supporting occupational safety programs, compliance, or risk management (retail or multi-site experience preferred)
Working knowledge of OSHA regulations and general safety compliance practices
Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret data and identify trends
Ability to collaborate and influence cross-functional teams
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Copilot)
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Excellent organizational and time management skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Demonstrated ability to maintain attention to detail and accuracy

WORKING CONDITIONS

Travel required approximately 20–50%, including periodic overnight stays
Work is performed across a variety of environments, including retail store locations, distribution centers/warehouses, and corporate office settings
Role requires regular movement throughout store and warehouse environments, including walking and standing for extended periods during site visits, audits, and inspections
Occasional handling of materials or equipment, which may involve lifting or moving items up to 50 pounds
Occasional work outside of standard business hours, including evenings or weekends, may be required based on business needs

The pay range for this position is $90,800.00 - $125,000.00 / Year with the opportunity for eligible associates to earn additional compensation pursuant to the Company’s bonus plan. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Full-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life and disability benefits. Part-time positions are eligible for dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. For additional information concerning our benefits, visit our Benefits and Career Development page: https://learn.bswift.com/ulta

About

At Ulta Beauty
(NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful
. Ulta Beauty is the largest North American beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products and salon services. We bring possibilities to life through the power of beauty each and every day in our stores and online with more than 25,000 products from approximately 500 well-established and emerging beauty brands across all categories and price points, including Ulta Beauty’s own private label. Ulta Beauty also offers a full-service salon in every store featuring—hair, skin, brow, and make-up services.

We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest records, conviction records, or other criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of any applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the New York City Fair Chance Act.

Plan and coordinate institutional onboarding, transition education, networking, cultural experiences, and community engagement opportunities that promote preparedness, belonging, cultural adjustment, and long-term integration.
Connect IMG physicians and their families with appropriate organizational and community resources based on identified transition needs.
Serve as the primary non-clinical liaison for IMG integration, coordinating communication, roles, handoffs, and services among Medical Education, Human Resources, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Information Technology, Graduate Medical Education leadership, residency coordinators, and other organizational partners.
Provide consultation and education to residency coordinators, department leaders, and organizational partners regarding IMG integration processes, available resources, role boundaries, and organizational practices that support a consistent trainee experience.
Develop and maintain standardized workflows, program resources, tracking systems, and process documentation that support consistent IMG integration services.
Collection and analyze program data, participant feedback, and recurring barriers; prepare reports and recommendations for leadership; and identify improvements to organizational workflows, communications, resources, and support services.
Perform other duties as required.

Other Information

Technical Expertise

Demonstrated ability to independently coordinate a complex portfolio of International Medical Graduates and international fellows, balancing competing priorities, time-sensitive deadlines, and interdependent processes across the physician-training lifecycle.
Working knowledge of immigration-related administrative processes affecting international physicians and trainees, including authorized sponsorship pathways, Intealth, ECFMG, SEVIS-related processes, documentation requirements, renewals, extensions, and institutional dependencies. Ability to monitor evolving requirements and communicate operational impacts while maintaining appropriate legal boundaries.
Strong understanding of graduate medical education, physician onboarding, healthcare operations, and organizational systems, with the ability to navigate complex structures, clarify responsibilities, and coordinate cross-functional solutions.
Demonstrated systems-thinking, consultation, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify administrative and systemic barriers, analyze complex situations, exercise sound judgment, influence outcomes without direct authority, and coordinate timely responses involving internal and external stakeholders.
Experience developing program infrastructure and evaluating effectiveness, including standardized workflows, resource materials, tracking systems, process documentation, data analysis, trend identification, and preparation of reports and recommendations for leadership.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex administrative processes into practical guidance, build trusting relationships across diverse cultural and professional groups, maintain confidentiality,
Proficiency in MS Office [Outlook, Excel, Word] or similar software is required including relevant databases or case-management systems to support program administration.

Education And Experience

new_jobs.description:
Hawthorn Children’s Psychiatric Hospital provides specialized care for adolescents diagnosed with mental health disorders. We are looking for a positive and energetic teacher to work collaboratively with a team of educators.

This unit will work closely with community partners and collaborate with our adolescent’s community schools. This person must have an interest in helping adolescents with mental health disorders while maximizing each student’s potential. Our educators provide instruction to youth in our Inpatient and Residential Programs guided by a Missouri DESE course of study, but have the ability, as well, to exercise creativity and flexibility in adapting coursework to fit the needs and abilities of the students you teach.

Your time with the students allows you to see the difference we make in the lives of the children in our care. As a teacher at Hawthorn, you will receive ongoing guidance and training with the ability to collaborate with peers, work intensively with other disciplines, and receive classroom support; all while providing you the opportunity to flourish in your professional in your role with the students and the facility.

Responsibilities

Individualize instruction to meet student needs in a mixed placement, mixed ability classroom of 4-8 students.
Revise, develop and implement Individual Education Plans (IEPs) and Section 504 Plans.
Attend and contribute to multi-disciplinary meetings regarding students in your classroom.
Develop treatment goals for classroom use and report on those goals weekly.
Model and teach social skills to the students in your classroom.
Keep attendance and academic records and report on those records at specific times.

The qualified candidate will have at minimum a Bachelor’s Degree in Education from an accredited university and
have 4 years of post-baccalaureate teaching experience in a school accredited by a state approved governing agency. The candidate must possess a Missouri Department of Elementary and Secondary Education Lifetime or Career Continuous Professional Certification (CCPC) noting an area of special education.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess The Following Skills

Ability to write effective Individualized Education Plans (IEPs) with limited assistance.
A basic knowledge of Microsoft Products especially word and excel

Collaboration with a multi-disciplinary team
Tuition Reimbursement

Opportunities to participate in different committees within the facility

new_jobs.description:
Overview

Realize
new levels of autonomy and professional ownership. At Ulta Beauty, our Legal, Risk & Governance team provides clarity and continuity in ways that have made our growth a seamless venture, with keen insights that have opened up new and previously unexplored areas of opportunity. Through superior leadership and work that continually challenges, you’ll have the chance to help set strategic direction through ethical and collaborative thought and practice.

THE IMPACT YOU CAN HAVE

The Retail Safety Program Manager leads the execution and continuous improvement of Ulta Beauty’s Beautifully Safe program across all Ulta Beauty retail store locations. The role is responsible for developing, implementing and managing retail store safety programs that protect employees, guests and company assets. This role partners closely with Store Operations, Risk Management, Asset Protection, People Success and Growth & Development to reduce workplace injuries, ensure regulatory compliance, improve safety performance, and foster a culture of safety throughout Ulta Beauty’s retail store locations.

YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH THESE GOALS BY:

Safety Program Management

Develop and maintain retail store safety policies and procedures
Lead company-wide store safety initiatives focused on injury prevention and risk mitigation
Standardize safety practices across all store locations
Evaluate safety performance metrics and implement continuous improvement and operational excellence strategies
Prepare reports and presentations for senior leadership outlining safety performance, trends, and program effectiveness.

Regulatory Compliance

Ensure regulatory compliance with OSHA and all applicable federal, state and local safety regulations
Perform investigations related to OSHA complaints and inspections, including documentation and follow-up.
Serve as liaison with government agencies and inspectors
Maintain required safety documentation and records
Monitor changes in regulatory requirements and update policies accordingly
Benchmark safety program with retail professionals across the industry, attend conferences and stay active in industry trade associations
Track and support contagious disease control programs, including reporting and regulatory compliance.

Incident Management

Conduct investigations and root cause analysis of employee and guest injuries and incidents
Prepare injury prevention action plans
Monitor workers’ compensation and general liability trends

Store Safety Audits

Perform safety audits, safety assessments and inspections, in person and on CCTV
Identify hazards and partner with store management and field leaders to ensure corrective actions are completed
Review safety equipment, housekeeping, ergonomics and fire prevention.

Training & Development

Design and lead safety training for store field leadership and associates, including tracking completion and effectiveness.
Manage ongoing safety awareness initiatives through communications, meetings, and engagement programs across the enterprise.
Train field leaders and store associates on polices and safety best practices
Prepare reports and presentations for leadership outlining safety performance, trends, and program effectiveness.

Risk Reduction

Analyze safety and risk-related data to identify trends and recommend mitigation strategies.
Evaluate and implement safety-related technologies and tools to improve risk mitigation.
Partner with Operations and Facilities to address physical hazards
Manage business relationships with third party safety solution providers

Emergency Preparedness

Coordinate and support safety committees, safety captain programs, and emergency response initiatives such as evacuation and shelter-in-place procedures
Partner with Business Continuity, Asset Protection and Store Operations on emergency response incidents and procedures
Develop and support emergency procedures at Ulta Beauty’s corporate headquarters

The Essentials Of Success

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
5–7 years of experience supporting occupational safety programs, compliance, or risk management (retail or multi-site experience preferred)
Working knowledge of OSHA regulations and general safety compliance practices
Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret data and identify trends
Ability to collaborate and influence cross-functional teams
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Copilot)
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Excellent organizational and time management skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Demonstrated ability to maintain attention to detail and accuracy

WORKING CONDITIONS

Travel required approximately 20–50%, including periodic overnight stays
Work is performed across a variety of environments, including retail store locations, distribution centers/warehouses, and corporate office settings
Role requires regular movement throughout store and warehouse environments, including walking and standing for extended periods during site visits, audits, and inspections
Occasional handling of materials or equipment, which may involve lifting or moving items up to 50 pounds
Occasional work outside of standard business hours, including evenings or weekends, may be required based on business needs

The pay range for this position is $90,800.00 - $125,000.00 / Year with the opportunity for eligible associates to earn additional compensation pursuant to the Company’s bonus plan. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Full-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life and disability benefits. Part-time positions are eligible for dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. For additional information concerning our benefits, visit our Benefits and Career Development page: https://learn.bswift.com/ulta

About

At Ulta Beauty
(NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful
. Ulta Beauty is the largest North American beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products and salon services. We bring possibilities to life through the power of beauty each and every day in our stores and online with more than 25,000 products from approximately 500 well-established and emerging beauty brands across all categories and price points, including Ulta Beauty’s own private label. Ulta Beauty also offers a full-service salon in every store featuring—hair, skin, brow, and make-up services.
